correctness.summary: Stirling asymptotics force a=b-1/2 and c>=log sqrt(2pi); the next digamma term forces b^2-b+1/6<=0, while small-x behavior excludes b>1/2. A positive Laplace kernel proves strict complete monotonicity throughout the remaining interval.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The 2015 source gives only 0<b<=1/2 as a general necessary condition and sufficiency on [1/2-sqrt(3)/6,1/2]. Searches of the exact family, threshold, polynomial obstruction, source DOI, later review literature, and synonymous formulations did not locate the global classification.

value.summary: The theorem closes the remaining parameter gap and identifies the exact lower boundary, turning a partial characterization into a complete if-and-only-if classification with a direct positive-kernel mechanism.

limitations: The result concerns one specific gamma-remainder family.
Equivalent prior coverage under substantially different notation remains a residual originality risk.
The literature search is targeted rather than exhaustive.
Independent audit has not been performed.
